title: mrLAE with Less Ciphertext Expansion
summary: A generic mrLAE construction adds two ciphertext blocks, while achieving mrLAE security with lower expansion remains open.

formal_statement.body: A generic construction achieves misuse-resistant leakage-resilient authenticated-encryption (mrLAE) security but produces ciphertexts two blocks longer than their messages. Construct an mrLAE-secure authenticated-encryption scheme with ciphertext expansion of less than two blocks, ideally only one block.

scope.domain: Design of misuse-resistant, leakage-resilient authenticated-encryption schemes.
parameters: Ciphertext expansion, measured in blocks, is the efficiency target
scope.unresolved_remainder: Construct an mrLAE-secure scheme with less than two blocks of ciphertext expansion, ideally one block.

citations.label: Authenticated Encryption in the Face of Protocol and Side Channel Leakage

progress.summary: The source presents a generic mrLAE construction with two-block ciphertext expansion and explicitly leaves achieving the same security with less expansion open.
citation_labels: Guy Barwell et al., Authenticated Encryption in the Face of Protocol and Side Channel Leakage
